verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Asana hosts an actual llms.txt file at developers.asana.com/llms.txt, returning HTTP 200 with structured documentation guidance and markdown-append instructions, directly satisfying the story. This is corroborated by first-party developer docs describing the API/platform. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of agents actually using this llms.txt successfully, and no OpenAPI spec was found alongside it.
